name: macp_task_request
description: TaskRequest: opens the delegated task (RFC-MACP-0009 Section 4). Sent as message_type TaskRequest in mode macp.mode.task.v1.

task_id.description: Identifier of the task. Later task messages reference it.

instructions.description: What the assignee is asked to do.

requested_assignee.description: The participant asked to take the task. Empty means any eligible participant may accept it.

input.description: Opaque task input; empty if none. Base64-encoded (RFC-MACP-0001 Section 10.3).

deadline_unix_ms.description: Requested deadline in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.
